file_tools.6to5m: github.com/DesignWithTommy/6to5m - Rust CLI+MCP, RPF9 extract, TTPF->DDS/PNG, drawables->OBJ/GLB, VI->V conversion; GPL-3.0; no release

note: No playable GTA VI for PC exists. Any installer/launcher that says otherwise is fake or malware. A mod needs (1) a PC-runnable build the owner supplies, (2) a script/native dispatch, (3) an archive tool. Until then build against GTA V and keep the engine layer swappable.
